effect.en: Protects against Fire moves.  Once one has been blocked, the Pokémon's own Fire moves inflict 1.5× damage until it leaves battle.

flavor.en: If hit by a Fire-type move, the Pokémon absorbs the flames and uses them to power up its own Fire-type moves.
flavor.ko: 불꽃타입의 기술을 받으면 불꽃을 받아서 자신이 사용하는 불꽃타입의 기술이 강해진다.
